snippet.title: Vicious Circle Arcade
snippet.description:
The game is six buttons one but their implementation isn’t as straight forward. Five buttons act as basic attacks that have different properties based on whether the character is standing.
The six button is the "Berserk” mode, you have a meter bar under life to see when you can use it, press it will make the character rush at the opponents with an attack,let them open to combos. The meter slowly depletes when activated, giving the player a “timer” to go nuts.

The game has 9 characters bearing a Killer Instinct-esque look everyone with their unique moveset, "fatalities", "mutilations"(suicides) and do to the nature of the game, infinite combos.

Players needs to win two rounds, once a player depletes the opponent’s life meter for a second victory, the defeated character enters a stun state for a short time to allow for fatality move inputs.
You can execute an opener attack and then utilize a pre-determined normal move to link from the opener, this also works with special moves. There are no throws in the game, you can just combo and counter it.
Ironicaly the game has only one safeguard to keep players from endlessly linking their combos, but it  only prevents players from executing 100% juggle combos, you are allowed three juggle hits, the fourth will push the player back. On the ground instead, there is no limit, you can land has many combo you want, infinitely.

The game is also very unbalanced some characters are clearly better the others, there is also a damage scaling mechanic, but it doesn't matter, for example characters like Edge can get a good chunk of damage just with his wind kick.

The game lacks a ending and a final boss fight, making the game story kind hard to describe and the opening movie doesn't help either.
It also very unpolished, buggy and sometime glitchy, it may happen that the character textures will may glitch out making the game unable to be played, in that case you can only restart the game, losing the run.
